ctx.x: For the second time, I went just after New Year to a ski resort in Auvergne, a province of France, called Spur-Besse. A young friend of mine, the clarinetist Marc Lafferie, was organizing a jazz festival and the conception of that festival was unusual and very sympathetic. He invited about 100 musicians, professional and amateurs and we were all living in the same building which usually was used as a hotel for holidays for people of modest background.

The festival runs for a week, I would give a concert, but Lily and I would stay for the whole week. Many great artists would play there, also: Albert Nicholas, Benny Waters, Memphis Slim, The Golden Gate Quartet, Guy Lafitte, etc. The atmosphere was very exciting. Not only were there musicians and their families, but also people who came from everywhere as paying guests and would stay for the week. So there would always be somebody to talk with, drink with, make music with. In the day time, we would go out for a…

After Super-Besse, we went to Nice where we got a taste of spring, then in April, we went to Morocco to Meknes, Rabat and Casablanca. It had been very long time since my last trip there. This time, I was playing with a band directed by Jacques Largeaud, who played organ and piano. He was also a school teacher, and was very nice and interesting fellow and we had a swell time.
